name: hitreg-diagnostics
title: Hitreg Diagnostics (FiveM)
description: Creates a local connection report and shows how to inspect FiveM ping and packet loss.
deepDescription:
LOCAL CONNECTION REPORT
Creates a report in %LOCALAPPDATA%\BabaTweak\reports with your active adapter status, adapter error counters, gateway reachability, and a short ping sample to a public test endpoint. The report stays on this PC; it is not uploaded. ICMP tests can be blocked, so use them as a baseline only.

CHECK ACTUAL FIVEM HITREG
In FiveM, open the F8 console and run: cl_drawperf true. This displays the game client's FPS, ping, and packet loss while connected to your server. A high ping, unstable packet loss, server performance, or server-side scripts can affect how play feels. Windows cannot force a server to register hits differently.

COMPARE
Run the report before and after network changes, and compare the live FiveM display on the same server. Wired Ethernet, avoiding downloads during play, and choosing a nearby server are practical connection checks. This entry diagnoses; it does not modify Windows network settings.
